fusions.name: Boiler Burst
fusions.desc: Hurls a ball of boiling water that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. It then bursts and hits every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Thermal Shock
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. It deals 9 damage and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Scalding Mantle
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Head of Steam
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack of pressure builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blast of steam strikes the nearest enemy within 8 tiles for 34% of your weapon damage per stack (204% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
